description: Welcome to this luxurious loft-style apartment, fully renovated 140m2, located on the first floor of a classic Haussmannian building. Designed to provide a premium experience, it can accommodate up to 8 people.The space-3 bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms: Each room has its own modern bathroom with shower and toilet, offering privacy comparable to that of a luxury hotel.- Premium sofa bed: The living room is equipped with a very high quality sofa bed, ensuring a comfortable sleeping area for two additional guests.-Climatization and heating: The apartment has air conditioning in all bedrooms and living room, as well as underfloor heating for optimal comfort in winter.- Fully equipped kitchen: Ideal for preparing your meals, the kitchen has all the modern appliances you need.-3 WC total: In addition to en-suite bathrooms, a guest toilet is available in the living room.- Blackout shutters: For more privacy or for guests wishing to sleep in the living room, blackout shutters are installed.Loft-style decor: A luxurious decoration with a loft vibe, combining elegance and modernity.One of the major assets of this apartment is its central location and proximity to Le Marais, the most popular area of Paris, just 15 minutes walk and 5 minutes by car, where history and modernity mingle in an elegant and vibrant atmosphere.The apartment is in a great location for exploring Paris thanks to easy access to public transport:- Metro Jacques Bonsergent: Located a 1-minute walk away, a short walk from the apartment. It is served by the Paris metro line 5. - Metro République: 200 meters, about 4 minutes to walk.
